text:
Maya (Marketing): Heads up — post-launch social plan for the new inference benchmarks + webinar. Goal: drive signups and identify warm replies for SDR routing. Draft schedule: X thread (longform) + LinkedIn carousel + 1 static post for EMEA friendly time. Need final copy, assets, shortlink + UTM, and routing rules by Friday EOD. Pinged @Sam G for scheduling, @Priya R for copy, @Ollie (Design) for assets, @Ben for lead routing.

Sam G: on it. I can schedule X thread at 10:00am PT Mon and LinkedIn at 11:30am PT. Do we want X first, then LinkedIn?

Priya R: I have two copy variants in drafts — aggressive CTA (register now) and nurture CTA (join the convo). Posting both as A/B is smart. Examples: 
- Aggressive: "Ship inference like the pros — join our webinar + see benchmarks. Register: https://rwd.in/bench-reg?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=bench_launch"
- Nurture: "Curious how inference costs drop 2-3x? We'll show the numbers + playbook. RSVP: https://rwd.in/bench-reg?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=bench_nurture"

Ollie (Design): I'll export a LinkedIn carousel (5 slides) + 3 X cards (hero + alt crop) by Fri 5pm PT. Any specific visual callouts? want the benchmark chart on slide 2 and a cost breakdown on slide 4.

Ben - Growth: Routing note — we should treat any reply that includes pricing/quote asks or "demo"/"talk" as warm. Proposed rule: UTM contains "utm_campaign=bench_launch" + click -> create HubSpot contact with property "social_lead=warm". Alerts to SDR queue "Bench-Warm". Also set Slack alert to #sales-inbound for any DM that contains keywords.

Maya (Marketing): Ben — can you paste the exact webhook/criteria so Eng/SRE can validate? Also we want to avoid duplicating leads across channels.

Ben - Growth: Sure — pseudocode for matcher: 
```
if (utm_campaign == "bench_launch" && (reply_text contains "demo" || reply_text contains "pricing" || clicked_cta && message_text length > 20)){
  create_contact(payload)
  set_contact.property = "social_lead: warm"
  route_to_queue("Bench-Warm")
}
```
I'll send the prod webhook URL to @Sam G via DM.

Sam G: FYI — social scheduler (Buffer/our internal) supports webhooks on click. If hubspot mapping needs a specific field we can add it to the payload.

Priya R: Copy tweak suggestion for X thread: start with a quick stat, then CTA. Thread opener draft: "Benchmarks matter: same model, different serving stack -> 2.3x cost savings. Watch how we did it + join the webinar." Shorten the link with our shortener to capture UTM.

Ollie (Design): Quick Q — for the carousel, do we want the CTA on slide 5 to be "Register" or "Watch the replay"? For launch we'll use "Register." Replay CTA can be swapped later.

Maya (Marketing): Register for launch. Replay copy goes to evergreen nurture. Also we need follow-up DM sequence for people who click but don't register: 24h reminder + 3-day nudge with case snippet. Priya can draft.

Priya R: DM sequence (short): 
1) 24h: "Thanks for checking the post — spots filling fast, grab yours: <link>"
2) 3d: "Saw you were interested — here's a quick case study + webinar link"
3) 7d: "Final invite — hear the benchmark deep dive and Q&A"
I'll prepare microcopy for each.

social-bot: Scheduled: X thread (id: 987654321) -> 2026-04-06T17:00:00Z; LinkedIn carousel (id: 987654322) -> 2026-04-06T18:30:00Z. Hooks: click_webhook=true.

Ben - Growth: Once scheduled, I'll run a quick smoke test: click -> create test contact -> confirm Slack notif arrives in #sales-inbound. If all good, we'll flip to live webhook.

Maya (Marketing): Action list: 
- Priya: finalize A/B copy + DM sequence (due Thu EOD)
- Ollie: export assets (Fri 5pm PT)
- Sam: set scheduler + share preview links (Fri 6pm PT)
- Ben: share webhook criteria + run smoke (Mon morning)

Sam G: noted. I'll share preview links and GA/shortlink details in this thread when ready.

Ollie (Design): will add final PNG/SVG exports to the campaign folder and ping here.

Maya (Marketing): Great — last ask: can we experiment with two first replies on X? One reply that surfaces the webinar link and one reply that asks a qualifying question ("Interested in cost savings or latency? Reply with 'cost' or 'latency'") so we can capture intent. Ben: will that be okay for routing?

Ben - Growth: Yes — map reply keywords -> intent property in HubSpot. We'll prioritize replies that contain 'cost' or 'latency' as high-intent.

Priya R: I'll prepare quick scripts for the two bot replies.

Maya (Marketing): Perfect. Thanks team — we'll reconvene Mon after smoke test. :rocket:
